_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#000.dst: {p} içindeki [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda Şef Hamsey ile buluş.

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour! Restoranıma hoş geldin, izin ver de seni masana götüreyim-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: Gözlerim beni yanıltıyor mu? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: Bu sensin... çaylak askerken efsanelerin kahramanı olan kişi! Kim derdi?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: Diyar diyar gezen maceralarını duydum, mon ami! Je suis honore! Senin gibi biri benim restoranımda oturuyor!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Sen silahınla nasıl ünlüysen, ben de lezzetlerimle öyle ünlüyüm!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: Övünüyorum, övünüyorum. Je peu t'offrir un plat... ama belki ikimiz için başka bir teklifim vardır.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: Savaş sanatında ustalaşmış olabilirsin dostum, peki ya... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: Arkamdaki mutfağa gel, sana daha fazlasını anlatayım.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: Mutfağıma hoş geldin! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: Yanıyor olabilir ama... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: Neyse, mücadeleya dönelim. Biraz dostça rekabete ne dersin, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: En iyi üç şefimden biriyle bir yemek hazırlayıp bitince bana sunabilirsin!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: Yemeğini elbette yirmi dokuz Principes de Cuisine'e göre ben değerlendireceğim: doku, sunum, özgünlük...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: ... aroma, büyülü güç... ha, bir de lezzet!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plaît! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plaît! Git şeflerimin her biriyle tanış, kiminle çalışacağına karar verince geri gel!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs inside Hamsey's kitchen
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Hamsey'in mutfağındaki üç şefle de konuş

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: Selam! Hamsey'in bahsettiği maceracı sen olmalısın. Biliyor musun, neredeyse coşmuştu ama bunu dediğimi ona söyleme!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: Ooo, yemek yarışması mı? Ne heyecanlı! Sana seve seve yardım ederim. Belki böylece kendimi diğerlerine biraz daha kanıtlarım...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: Birlikte çalışırsak Baharatlı Voidroot Yahnisi yapabiliriz, kulağa nasıl geliyor?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding who to work with though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: Ama kiminle çalışacağına karar vermeden önce diğer şeflerle de konuşman lazım!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Hamsey'in iyi bir dostusun demek? Bu yarışmayı bir şekilde kazandığında - yok, kazanırsan - inanırım.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: Ben döktürürken senin gibi amatörlerin ayağıma dolanmasına ihtiyacım yok!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: Hâlâ burada mısın? Git... başka birine laf at, lütfen.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: Naber kanka. Adım Frank. Hamsey ikinizin eskiden beri tanıştığını söyledi. Hamsey'in her dostu benim de dostumdur, dostum.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: Ne pişireceğimizden pek emin değilim daha, vakti gelince aklıma bir şey gelir herhalde.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go too far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: Turta mı yapsak? Pek uğraştırmaz, fazla da batıramayız, değil mi?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: Hamsey ile konuş ve birlikte çalışacağın şefi seç.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah, tous mes cuisiniers ile tanıştın mı? Kiminle çalışmak istersin?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah, Brie! Mükemmel bir şef... peyniri ise daha da mükemmel! Şaka yapıyorum, şaka. İyi anlaşacağınızdan eminim.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah, Kale. En yetenekli şeflerimden biri, gerçi bazen inatçı olabiliyor!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! Bazen biraz... rahat görünebilir ama emin ol, son derece becerikli bir şeftir!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maintenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maintenant, mon ami, şefinin yanına git ve yemeğe başla!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about your dish

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: Yine selam! Baharatlı Voidroot Yahnisi'ni benimle yapmaya karar verdin demek? Yaşasın!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: Göründüğü kadar kolay değil ama bence birlikte üstesinden geliriz.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: Kendimi kanıtlamakla ilgili dediğim gibi... Bu mutfağın en yeni şefi benim ve bazı şefler fikirlerimi beğenmiyor. Bu benim fırsatım olabilir!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Aylardır Voidroot Yahnisi tarifini mükemmelleştiriyorum ve sonunda herkese neler yapabildiğimi gösterme şansım var!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: İlki Snail Island'da bulunan [Snail Slime]. Bu yemek için bir tane yeter.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: Sonra Void'in derinliklerinde bulunan çok nadir bir kök olan [Voidroot] lazım. {p} bölgesinde seni oraya götürebilecek biri olduğunu duydum.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: Son olarak bulması meşhur derecede zor olan [Moonsalt] lazım. Neyse ki kendini 'Uzay Büyücüsü' ilan eden Astralaus'ta biraz olmalı, kulesine uğrayıp istemen yeter!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: Bu kadar! Sana bir Tarif Kitabı vereceğim, açmak ve malzemelerini takip etmek için sağ tıkla. Bol şans!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: Bir işe yara da gereken her şeyi getir. Laflayacak havamda değilim.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: Senin gibilerin yüzünden itibarımın zedelenmesini istemiyorum...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: Dinle, bunu bir daha *söylemeyeceğim*. Not al.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: Muhteşem omletimin temel malzemesi tabii ki [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], ki bunu elbette bilmiyordun.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: İkinci olarak [Snail Slime] lazım, o da Snail Island'da, belli ki. Bunu deneyimli her şef söyler.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: Son olarak bataklık Sky Island'da bulunan bir [Talking Mushroom] lazım, tabii gözlerin çalışıyorsa.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: ŞİMDİDEN UNUTTUN MU?? SANA NOT AL DEMİŞTİM!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: Şansına, burada en azından birimiz işinin ehli. Her şeyi bu tarif kitabına yazdım. Açmak için sağ tıkla. Şimdi malzemelerimi getir ve defol!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: Seninle çalışacağım için çok heyecanlıyım, kanka! Hamsey'nin aklını alacağız.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: Hmmm, peki ne tür bir turta pişirsek acaba?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: Eh, biraz tembel olabilirim ama iş yemeğe gelince gözüm keskindir. Ve bana sorarsan kanka, tam bir Skyhigh Pie insanısın! Hehe.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: Eh, basit bir Skyhigh Pie yapmayı biliyorsundur herhalde, değil mi? Hadi bakalım, malzemeler sende olunca ben burada bekliyor olacağım.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: Hehe, şaka yapıyorum dostum! Yüzünü bir görecektin.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: Önce bir çeşit un lazım. Biraz [Sunrise Flour] iş görür.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: İri bir [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] tadına biraz canlılık katar. Gerçi yumurtalarını aşırdığını görürlerse grooklar sana daha sağlam bir tekme atar!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: Son olarak gizli malzeme: bir [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Çok iyi şeydir ama epey uzakta. Biraz yürümek kimseye zarar vermemiştir, değil mi? Gerçi ben hiç zahmet etmedim.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: Ha, hafızan mı zayıf? Benimki de dostum. Al sana bir Tarif Kitabı, sağ tıklayıp aç ve malzemeleri nereden alacağına bak!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: Hepsini bulunca buraya dön. Görüşürüz kanka!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Astralus'un Astral Evi'ne hoş geldin! Yer çekimini ters çevirerek tepeye çıkabilir misin?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: Astronomik ilerleme! Ama bu daha başlangıç!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: Benim Moonsalt'ım mı? Ne saçmalık! Ben benimkini kendim topladım, sen de seninkini topla! Adil olan bu.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: Kahrolası insanlar, hiç dinlemezsiniz! Dedim ki... Kendin. Git. Topla.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: Seni ne getirmek burada, yabancıcık? Ne adlamaların var? İn-san? Biz demek Humyn! Kötü seçmek, başka seç yabancıcık!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: Yardım için araştırmak? Ne çok kolaylıklar! Humynler yardımlamak ihtiyaç! Sen gözlemciler, humynler büyük krater-kayaya düşüçuştu!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: Yakansüt bitmek ve onu almanın tek yönü moonsalt! Biz şanskülçesi bulmak ve krater-kayada moonsalt keşfetmek!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: Arıtılmış moonsalt uzayvıza için yakansüt vermek! Kolaysızlık, uzayvız yok olmak. Humynler minicik Uzayvız yapmak!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: Şimdiki uzayvıza sadece tekil humyn sığmak. Yabancıcık yardım ederse humynler yabancıcığı uzayvıza almak. Humynler verilen zamanda yeni uzayvız yapabilmek!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: Humynler şimdi krater-kayada ikamet etmek, yani beklemek ölüm sonucu değil!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt kuzeydeki tuzmağarada keşfedilmek, yabancıcık yolu izlemek!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: Yakansüt için sadece [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] gerekmek, artanı yabancıcık alabilmek!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: Yabancıcıkta moonsalt olunca humyn yanındaki aletle arıtmak ve uzayvızla vızlamak!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: Merhaba veee Yüzyılın Yarış Pistine hoş geldin!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: Bir kazanan, bir kaybeden. Usnail Bolt da kaybedenleri kahvaltıda yer.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: Kahvaltı mı? Dur, ben kahvaltı ettim mi? Biraz kahvaltı iyi gid-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: Neyse, önemli değil. Ne dersin maceracı? Usnail Bolt'a karşı yarışa katıl. Büyük ödül biraz Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: Yazık, harika bir yarış olabilirdi. Görüşürüz maceracı!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: Bak sen şu işe... Görünüşe göre bu sefer de Usnail Bolt kazandı. Yine.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: Şanslı gününde değilsin insan. Neyse, kaybetmenin bedelini biliyorsun. Muhafızlar!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: Vay be! İnanılmaz geçen bir yarışta insan, liderliği Usnail Bolt'un burnunun dibinden kapmayı başardı!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: Al insan. Ödülün olarak bu balçığı al.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: BU HARİKA DEĞİL Mİ? BİR İNSAN?! KİMİN AKLINA GELİRDİ.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: BUGÜN YANIMDAN GEÇEN YEDİNCİ KİŞİSİN VE DİĞERLERİNDEN HİÇBİR FARKIN YOK.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: HEPSİNİN SURATINDA AYNI AVANAK, MAHCUP İFADE, SANKİ KONUŞAN MANTAR GÖKTEN DÜŞMÜŞ GİBİ.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: BIRAK ALLAH AŞKINA, BENİ ALIP BÖYLE SAYGISIZLIK EDEN DANGALAKLARDAN BIKTIM. KİŞİSEL ALAN, HİÇ DUYDUN MU?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: NEDEN UĞRAŞIYORUM Kİ. ŞU HALİNE BAK! TAM BİR SAFLIK ABİDESİ. ŞİMDİ NE OLACAK, BENİ SKY ISLANDS BOYUNCA ÇILGIN BİR MACERAYA MI SÜRÜKLEYECEKSİN?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: UMARIM DEĞİLDİR, ÖYLE DÜŞÜNÜYORSAN. BUGÜN ZATEN BİR SAPIMI KAYBETTİM, ÇÜNKÜ BİR BEYİNSİZ BENDEN ISIRIK ALMAYA ÇALIŞTI... CANLI CANLI!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: SÖYLEME, BENİ SKY ISLANDS BOYUNCA ÇILGIN BİR MACERAYA MI SÜRÜKLEYECEKSİN? NE GÜZEL.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: MUTFAK MI DEDİN, EH, BU ÇİLEMİ BİR AN ÖNCE BİTİRECEKSE NEDEN OLMASIN.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: DUR, BENİ NEDEN ÇANTANA TIKIYORSUN? BURADA NASIL NEFES ALMAMI BEKLİYORSUN?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: Merhaba! Gözüm tutuyor, biraz Sunrise Flour lazım sana, değil mi?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: Hemen mi lazım? Hiç tasalanma, dostum!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: Hay ekmeğimi yağlayıp kızartayım, bitmiş, hiç kalmamış.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I seem to be just loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: Boş boş oyalanıyormuşum gibi göründüysem kusura bakma ama mayası bende, nasıl yapılacağını biliyorum.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: Fırının yanındaki şu buğday tarlasını görüyor musun? Biraz buğday hasat edip değirmene atabilirsin.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: Hemen yandaki alet tüccarından bir tırpan kap ve işe koyul!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: İstediğin kadar yap, bugünlük ihtiyacım olan bütün ekmeği zaten yaptım.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: Selam ahbap! Skyhigh Raspberry mi arıyorsun? Turtada harika olurlar!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: İlgileniyorsan adaya girmek için ufak bir ücret var, sadece {~} Zümrüt.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: İnsan bir şekilde ekmeğini kazanmalı, ben de seni doğrudan yetiştikleri adaya çıkaracak bir top sistemi kurdum!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: Eee, ne dersin? Küçük bir macera için ufak bir bedel, üstüne yiyebildiğin kadar ahududu!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: Tamamdır! Yanımdaki adaya geç ve topa atla. Tamamen güvenli, söz veriyorum!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up to the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon to come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: Adaya çıkmanın yolunu bul ve istediğin kadar ahududu topla! İşin bitince kıyıya dönmek için büyük topa atla!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: Tamamdır, sorun yok. Canın çekerse ne zaman istersen gel!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: Tamam, sen geri çekil, yemeği ben hallederim, sadece malzemeleri ver!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: Aha! Bu iş tamam! Umarım her şeyi doğru yapmışımdır... ama vay, şu çorbanın rengine bak!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: Bunu Hamsey'e götürüp ne düşündüğüne bakmalısın!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: Her şey tamam mı? Amma geç kaldın.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: Başlayalım. Herkes çoktan bitirdi. Ben sihrimi konuştururken geride dur.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: Muah! Başyapıtım hazır. Bunu şefe sun, bayılacağına eminim!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: Ve götürürken DİKKAT ET. Ben ünlü olunca o yemek YÜZLERCE eder!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.dst: Her şey tamam mı? Süpersin kanka.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: Bu ahudududan azıcııık alayım, şefin payı, değil mi? Hadi başlayalım!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: Al bakalım kanka. Seninle çalışmak güzeldi. Bunu Hamsey'e götür, bakalım ne diyecek. Yolda bir kısmını "kaybetmediğinden" emin ol, kendi malından yemek hakkında ne derler bilirsin!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, yemeğini bitirdin mi? O halde, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: Özel yemek salonuma geçelim... bu taraftan!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki yemek salonunda Hamsey ile buluş.

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: Tekrar hoş geldin, mon ami! Görüyorum ki elinde bir yemekle dönmüşsün!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: Yahni mi? Basit görünüyor ama hayattaki en basit şeyler bile le meilleur olabilir!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: Maceracı, bu yemeği sen yaptığına emin misin? O kadar güzel ki restoranı kapatsam yeridir!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: Beni şaşırtmaktan hiç vazgeçmiyorsun dostum. Al, bu önlüğü al, her gerçek şefin olmazsa olmazıdır.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: Yemeğinin hazır olduğunu fark etmeden edemedim!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: Yemeğini tadayım, ben de sana benimkini sunayım! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. Bir katırın derrière'sini ısırmayı tercih ederim! Bu şeye... bir Gert bile dokunmaz!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Görüyorum ki yemek sanatında hiç ilerlememişsin. Beni rahat bırak, iyi yemeğin ne olduğunu öğrenince gel!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: Döndüğünü görüyorum, hem de eli boş değil. Lütfen, ne yarattığını göster bana!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: Turta mı? Sana Frank yardım etmiş olmalı. Turta yapmaya hep bir zaafı vardır!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: Görüyorum ki compétences culinaires'in çok gelişmiş!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Sana henüz gerçek bir usta şef demem ama très bien! Tebrik olarak bu ödülü al!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#141.src: Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#141.dst: Maceracı! Henüz Brie, Kale ya da Frank ile konuşmadın, kiminle çalışacağını seçmeden önce onlarla konuştuğundan emin ol.
Recipe For Disaster#141.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#142.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
Recipe For Disaster#142.dst: Naber kanka. Adım Frank. Tanıştığımıza memnun oldum.
Recipe For Disaster#142.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#144.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
Recipe For Disaster#144.dst: Hâlâ burada mısın? Git... başka biriyle laflaş, Hâlâ burada mısın? Git... başka birilütfen.
Recipe For Disaster#144.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#145.src: You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
Recipe For Disaster#145.dst: Üç şefle de konuştun, Hamsey'in yanına dönmelisin.

Recipe For Disaster#146.src: Which chef you would like to cook with?

Recipe For Disaster#148.src: Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
Recipe For Disaster#148.dst: Bana pek ısınamadın mı? Dert değil! Kiminle çalışırsan çalış harika iş çıkaracağına eminim.
Recipe For Disaster#148.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#149.src: Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
Recipe For Disaster#149.dst: Grook'a şükür beni seçmedin. Ayağıma bağ olacak bir amatöre daha hiç ihtiyacım yok.
Recipe For Disaster#149.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#150.src: Collect [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#150.dst: [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#151.src: Collect [{~} Voidroot] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#151.dst: [{~} Voidroot] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#152.src: Collect [{~} Moonsalt] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#152.dst: [{~} Moonsalt] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#153.src: Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#153.dst: [{~} Snail Slime] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#154.src: Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#154.dst: [{~} Talking Mushroom] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#155.src: Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#155.dst: [{~} Sunrise Flour] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#156.src: Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#156.dst: [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] topla, konum: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Ya da tarif kitabına bak.

Recipe For Disaster#157.src: You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!

Recipe For Disaster#158.src: How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
Recipe For Disaster#158.dst: Yemek nasıl gidiyor?! Tarif kitabını kaybettiysen şefinden yeni bir kopya iste!

Recipe For Disaster#159.src: Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.dst: Beni mutfağa kadar takip et, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#160.src: You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
Recipe For Disaster#160.dst: Değirmende işlemek için [{~} Sunrise Wheat] lazım!
Recipe For Disaster#160.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#161.src: You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
Recipe For Disaster#161.dst: Biraz Sunrise Wheat hasat ettin, şimdi fırıncının değirmeninde işlemelisin.

Recipe For Disaster#162.src: Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
Recipe For Disaster#162.dst: Yumurtayla kaçmayı başardın gibi görünüyor... kıl payı kurtuldun!

Recipe For Disaster#163.src: Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?
Recipe For Disaster#163.dst: Biraz Skyhigh Raspberry toplamak ister misin?

Recipe For Disaster#166.src: You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
Recipe For Disaster#166.dst: Adaya gidiş ücretini zaten ödedin, hemen yanımdaki adadaki topa atla!
Recipe For Disaster#166.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#167.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
Recipe For Disaster#167.dst: Bütün malzemeleri topladın, Frank'in yanına dönmelisin.

Recipe For Disaster#168.src: You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
Recipe For Disaster#168.dst: Raspberry Vendor ile konuşmadan adalara atlamamalısın!

Recipe For Disaster#169.src: You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
Recipe For Disaster#169.dst: Hamsey'in yemeğini tatmaya başlamasını izliyorsun... acaba beklentilerini karşılayacak mı?

Recipe For Disaster#171.src: Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#171.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#172.src: Good to see you again, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#172.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#173.src: Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
Recipe For Disaster#173.dst: Ah. Döndün. Sadece ayağıma dolanma, burada gerçek yemek yapmaya çalışıyorum.
Recipe For Disaster#173.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#174.src: Hey! Nice to see you again.
Recipe For Disaster#174.speaker: Brie
